transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, well, what brought me in is that I keep getting in trouble at work. I work on a production floor, and I just keep leaving my station when I'm supposed to stay put. 

Or, like, if we have a team meeting, I'll just pop up out of my chair and start walking around. My supervisor told me it's becoming a real safety problem, because I just take off before I even think about it. So, I guess I'm here to figure out how to stop doing that.
Have you had times when your mood felt unusually high or irritable?
No, not really. I mean, I get frustrated sometimes if things are moving too slow, but I wouldn't say my mood gets unusually high or anything. I just feel normal, just... restless, I guess.
Since you were a child, have you often felt unable to stay seated when you were expected to?

Yeah, pretty much always. Um, even back in elementary school, I was the kid who just couldn't stay in my seat. I talked over the teacher a lot, and... well, I was always getting notes sent home because I kept blurting things out or just wandering around the room when I wasn't supposed to. So, yeah, it's been an issue since I was little.
Do you often have trouble keeping your attention on tasks?

Yeah, I do. Like, um, when I'm doing inventory logs or having to read through the CNC training pages at work... I start out really trying to focus on it. But after just a few minutes, it's like the numbers or the words just start to blur together. I end up having to keep going back and re-reading the same thing over and over because I realize I didn't actually take any of it in.
Do you often act before thinking?

Um, not really, no. I mean, I might talk out of turn sometimes or get restless, but I don't feel like I'm doing things without thinking about them first. I don't really make rash decisions or anything like that.
